session_2.speaker: Maya
session_2.text: My first pottery class was on April 13. I finished the blue mug and learned how to pull a handle without cracking it.

session_2.speaker: Noah
session_2.text: That is a strong start. Did you also make the herb planter you talked about?

session_2.speaker: Maya
session_2.text: Yes. I glazed the herb planter green and gave it to my sister Lena for her kitchen window.

session_2.speaker: Noah
session_2.text: Lena will love it. The blue mug and green planter sound like a cheerful first pair of projects.

session_1.speaker: Maya
session_1.text: I joined the Harbor Pottery Club last Saturday because I want a quiet hobby after work.

session_1.speaker: Noah
session_1.text: That sounds perfect for you. When does your first class begin?

session_1.speaker: Maya
session_1.text: The first class is April 13. I plan to make a blue mug and an herb planter.
session_1.blip_caption: two unfinished clay pieces beside a small bowl of blue glaze

session_1.speaker: Noah
session_1.text: A mug and planter are practical choices. Tell me how the class goes.
